Planning a visit to the Schengen Area?

Agha Travel & Tours helps Pakistani applicants navigate the short-stay visa (Type C) process with practical guidance, accurate application preparation and documentation tailored to the purpose of travel.

Visa at a Glance

A short-stay Schengen visa can permit travel within the 29-country Schengen Area, subject to its entry count, validity and permitted days. The standard framework is up to 90 days in any 180-day period, although individual Pakistani applicants may receive shorter grants. Fees are EUR 90 for adults and EUR 45 for children aged 6–11.

Short-Stay Visa (Type C)Schengen Area · from Pakistan

What You Should Know

The essentials of the Schengen Area Short-Stay Visa (Type C), before you start your file.

01

Who This Visa Is For

Apply to the country that is your main destination, normally based on your main purpose or longest stay. Where no main destination can be identified, first entry can determine the correct consulate. Applying to whichever country seems easiest is not the right approach.

02

Important Country-Specific Guidance

Single-entry, double-entry and multiple-entry visas are possible. Your visa sticker specifies the authorized days and entries. A longer validity does not override the applicable short-stay limits.

03

A Personalised Application, Not a Generic Checklist

Each application is assessed against the traveller’s actual circumstances. Our team helps you present relevant information clearly and consistently, rather than adding unnecessary paperwork or repeating documents that do not support your case.

Checklist

Documents You Should Prepare

A starting point for your Schengen Area file. Our consultants tailor the final checklist to your travel purpose and profile.

Get My Checklist
  • Valid passport
  • Travel itinerary
  • Hotel or host arrangements
  • Proof of sufficient funds
  • Proof of work or business
  • Travel medical insurance
  • Documents explaining the purpose of the trip

Requirements vary by consulate.

Schengen Area Visa Application

Practical steps, professional support and clear next actions.

01

How We Help You Apply

We help select the correct destination consulate, prepare a consistent multi-country itinerary, review insurance and finances, organize documents and guide appointment booking.

02

Application & Submission Process

Applicants generally attend a visa application centre or consulate appointment and provide biometrics where required. Some family or business visits need destination-specific invitation or sponsorship forms.

03

Before You Make Travel Plans

Processing typically takes around 15–60 days. The responsible Schengen authority makes the final decision.
